final_topology.title: Government Secure Network
final_topology.description: Connect main data center to regional and branch offices with secure internet and remote access.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a main data center, a regional office, and a branch office connected via a dedicated WAN. It features a secure internet perimeter with email and web filtering, and remote access capabilities.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n26) and 'Asset Management System 2' (n_new1) that manage various nodes across different zones, indicating an asset inventory is maintained.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n27) that manages data flow links, indicating data flows are documented.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., Main Data Center, DMZ, Non-Production Zone) with specific nodes and links, indicating data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Server Firewall' (n30) in the 'Server Zone' (z12), indicating firewalls are implemented on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n22) in the 'Main Data Center' (z1), indicating trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' (n18) and 'Remote Access Wireless Controller' (n17) in the 'Remote Access' zone (z5), indicating MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Filter' (n11) and 'Email Filter' (n12) in the 'DMZ' (z4), indicating DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n23) in the 'Main Data Center' (z1), indicating network-based URL filters are enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones with specific nodes and links, indicating a secure network architecture is established and maintained.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Tool' (n31) that manages various nodes, indicating network infrastructure is securely managed using version-controlled Infrastructure-as-Code.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' (n18) in the 'Management Zone' (z7), indicating centralized network AAA is implemented.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Gateway' (n13) and 'Remote Access Router' (n15) in the 'Remote Access' zone (z5), indicating remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n19) in the 'Management Zone' (z7), indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative work are established and maintained.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS Sensor' (n20) in the 'Main Data Center' (z1), indicating a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple firewalls and routers with specific links between zones, indicating traffic filtering is performed between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NAC Server' (n24) in the 'Main Data Center' (z1), indicating access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Log Collector' (n32) that collects data from various nodes, indicating network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS Sensor' (n21) in the 'Main Data Center' (z1), indicating a network intrusion prevention solution is deployed.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Port-Level Access Control' (n_new2) that manages various nodes, indicating port-level access control is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n23) in the 'Main Data Center' (z1), indicating application layer filtering is performed.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z8) that is separate from other zones, indicating production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Pen Test Tool' (n33) that performs data flows to various zones, indicating periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z6 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z8 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various zones and nodes, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes to indicate asset tracking.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes data flow links, but there is no explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit documentation of data flows is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant data flow links.

findings_before.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
findings_before.evidence: There are no servers explicitly shown in the topology, and no firewalls are directly linked to servers.
findings_before.missing_reason: No servers or server firewalls are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add server nodes and link them to firewalls.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices, but there is no explicit evidence of secure management practices.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit secure management practices are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing IaC tools and secure network protocols, and link them to network devices.

findings_before.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a SIEM (n25) and links to NIDS and NIPS sensors, but there is no explicit evidence of collecting network traffic flow logs.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit collection of network traffic flow logs is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a log collector and links to network devices.

findings_before.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
findings_before.evidence: There is no explicit evidence of port-level access control (e.g., 802.1x) in the topology.
findings_before.missing_reason: No port-level access control mechanisms are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a NAC server and links to network devices.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: There is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests in the topology.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit penetration testing processes or tools are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing tool or service and links to relevant zones.
